test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'SPIT' is coded as ‘USKW’ and 'COPY' is coded as ‘ERRB’. How will 'MOCK' be coded in that language?
solution:
The position and positional values of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'SPIT' is coded as ‘USKW’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd41d46a29412ba36bd7a388dedf7b326fec1fa0abd8563ef5d937af929b972a.png] 

For, 'COPY' is coded as ‘ERRB’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cd104549d636338b0ad016cf886e0d6d5d024cf01a73711d03fb102a8a0a984.png] 

Similarly 'MOCK' will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6375fbc7b9d8e9408102bf1811ad767c6f8992547a75aa8b20cc1c96bc05cafe.png] 

So, **'MOCK' **will be written as** 'OREN'.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 4'.***
